neighbours.label: a repeat occurrence of a yearly event: German 'zum 29. Mal' and 'from last year'
fire: Das Stadtfest findet in diesem Jahr bereits zum 12. Mal statt.
Der Lauf begeistert schon zum 34. Mal die Zuschauer.
The hill was as steep as I remembered from last year.
The food was as good as we recalled from last year.
Die Messe öffnet nun zum 18. Mal ihre Tore.
The crowd was as loud as I remembered from last year.
Das Konzert lockt zum 40. Mal viele Besucher an.
The beach was as clean as we remembered from last year.
quiet: Das Stadtfest findet in diesem Jahr auf dem Markt statt.
Der Lauf begeistert schon im Mai die Zuschauer.
The hill was as steep as a very tall wall.
The food was as good as any in the region.
Die Messe öffnet nun im Herbst ihre Tore.
The crowd was as loud as a small jet.
Das Konzert lockt zum ersten Mal viele Besucher an.
The beach was as clean as a new kitchen.

notes: Card: ' Mal' at the top, ' year' second. Probes: ' Mal' after a number 0.86, 'zum ersten Mal' 0.09, ' year' in 'remembered from last year' 0.73; the same sentences without a repeat under 0.08. The rest of the pole's top is unexplained.
